_meta.purpose: Vendor dial-code / SMDI-integration templates per PBX model (the Stratagy FL.PBX set). Model-generic, NOT customer data. Backs 'Compare with Toshiba default' (voicemail-map §5.4). Starter set: CIX100S, transcribed from a live card's C:\Stratagy\PBX.DB\CIX100S.PBX. The full 40-model set ships with VM Manager and is added as each is transcribed.

models.CIX100S:
pbx_name 'Strata CIX 100 w/SMDI'
dl_init  # What to dial when the system first starts up
dl_dtwait F- # Dial code to put a caller on transfer hold
dl_ndtret F- # Dial code to use when there is no transfer dialtone
dl_rnaret F- # Dial code to return to caller after Ring No Answer
dl_bsyret F- # Dial code to return to caller when there is a Busy
dl_hupret F- # Dial code to use after a call screening reject
dl_connect H # Dial code to connect the caller to the extension
dl_prefix  # What to dial BEFORE dialing the User ID extension
dl_suffix  # What to dial AFTER dialing the User ID extension
dl_stop  # What to dial when the system performs a shutdown
dl_pickup  # What to dial when a port goes off-hook
integration 30 'Axxxxxxrrrr0000000000'
integration 30 'Bxxxxxxbbbb0000000000'
integration 30 'Nxxxxxxrrrr0000000000'
integration 30 'Dxxxxxxxxxxcccccceeee'
integration 30 'Siiiiiiiiii'
